lines.x: The South African rand slid toward 17.49 per dollar, prompting the South African Reserve Bank to warn it will not hesitate to hike rates again if needed, with inflation seen above 5% into 2027.
South Africa's headline annual consumer inflation accelerated to 5.2% in October from 4.5% in September, reaching its highest level since May 2024.
South Africa's central bank kept its key interest rate unchanged on November 19 after a 4-to-3 vote.
The South African Reserve Bank maintained its repo rate at 7.25% in a 4-3 vote, leaving the commercial prime lending rate at 10.75%, while three members favored a 25-bps rate hike.
